title: Returning Rented Equipment and Cancelling Undelivered Orders, Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
Terms of rental for patients holding Durable Medical Equipment Rentals placements: ending a rental by returning the equipment, and cancelling an order that has not been delivered.

## Terms

1. A patient may return rented equipment or cancel an undelivered order only by their own confirmation recorded on an intake. The request is recorded as an intake (an equipment return or an order cancellation), and the patient's own confirmation ends the rental or the order.
2. The rental ends on the return date. The rental month in which the return falls is paid in full where the class does not prorate a partial rental month, and no later month is paid.
3. The supplier collects returned equipment within the class's pickup period in business days.
4. Owned or purchased equipment is never returned for credit.

On a confirmed return the placement becomes returned and its return date is the date the rental ends; on a confirmed cancellation the order becomes cancelled and its date is the date cancelled.

## What each placement status allows under these terms

| Placement status | Return of rented equipment | Cancellation of the order |
|---|---|---|
| Ordered (not delivered) | - | Allowed, by the patient's own confirmation recorded on an intake |
| In rental | Allowed, by the patient's own confirmation recorded on an intake | - |
| Owned | Never returned for credit | - |
| Purchased | Never returned for credit | - |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical rental in a class that does not prorate partial months is returned on the twelfth day of its rental month 5. The rental ends on that return date; rental month 5 is paid in full, and rental month 6 and every later month are not paid. The supplier collects the equipment within the class's pickup period.

## Points of judgement

- The patient's own confirmation is what ends the rental or the order; recording the request on an intake alone does not.
- A return ends the rental on the return date itself; the month in which it falls is the last month paid.
